label: At most one body mate per form token at each time
term: At most one body mate per form token at each time
definition: UniqueAt r requires any two attachments of one form token at the SAME time to have equal body tokens. It does not compare different times, identify a person, establish a living body or substantial-form semantics, or preclude distinct parts of one organism sharing its form. Entire-body applicability is OPEN.
